content.text:
Both reported problems trace to a single line, `src/paginate.js:4`: `pageCount` used `Math.floor(total / size)`, so a trailing partial page was dropped from the count.

- **Last partial page never shows up** — `paginate` validates `page > pages` and bails out with an empty list, so with 7 items at size 3 page 3 was treated as out of range.
- **Summary one page too few** — `src/summary.js` calls the same `pageCount`, so 21 results at size 10 reported 2 pages.

Changing it to `Math.ceil` fixes both; no other changes were needed. Edge cases hold: `total = 0` still yields 0 pages, and exact multiples are unchanged since `ceil` and `floor` agree there.

I added one test per symptom (7 items at size 3 returning `[7]` on page 3; `summarize(21, 10)`). All 6 tests pass, including the three pre-existing ones.
